title: Continuation for batched Fourier observations
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ and $S\subseteq J$, and let $m\in\mathbb N$. Given three lists of $m$ sign vectors, a list of rational observations, and a continuation that takes a list of rational observations to a membership-query program with output type $\beta$, this program processes the vectors in order. At each position it takes the coordinates outside $J$ from the first vector and the coordinates on $J$ from the second and third vectors, queries the target at the two resulting combined vectors, charges $2n+2|S|+1$ local steps, and adds the resulting rational restricted Fourier weight observation; after all $m$ positions it passes the observations in their original order to the continuation.
